description: This Java class acts as a command handler for updating entries in a one-to-many data table within the Fineract framework. It processes commands to update data table entries by delegating to a service.

classes.name: UpdateOneToManyDatatableEntryCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands related to updating one-to-many data table entries.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to update a data table entry, delegating the operation to the DatatableWriteService.
